content: Pitiiŋ to Abaram paaghu tooni siriv
Murei ra, Abaram ivai livaa ite eeza Ketura.
Ketura ipoop natŋa liim ve ee. Ezazi tauvene: Simran, Yoksan, Medan, Midian, Isbak, ve Sua.
Yoksan natŋa, ene: Seba ve Dedan. Dedan paaghu tooni, ene yes Asura, Letusa, ve Leuma.
Midian natŋa, ene: Epa, Eper, Anok, Abida, ve Elda. Yes tane, ta tivot ila to Abaram gha Ketura.
Abaram ipul gabua tooni naol isov ila to naatu Isak.

Eemon saawe tau Abaram ilepleep maata yaryaare soone, irei gabua tooni siriv pa natŋa zitamoot to Agar ve Ketura paam. Ra ighur zi tila pa taan sirivu tau igheen ila pa aaz puughu na. Leso tileep tigharau naatu Isak sov.
Abaram imaat
Abaram lepoogh tooni poia mon le imin kooŋ kat. Ndaman tooni irau 175, ra imaat, ve ila ileep tomania ziiri waaro tooni tau timaat muuŋ na.
Abaram natŋa ru, Isak ve Ismael, tighur paata iloŋ ila maet puura tau igheen ila taan Makpela igharau nugh Mamre. Muuŋ, taan tawe to Zoar naatu Epron. Zoar, i Hit tamazi.
Abaram ighol taan tawe ila to yes Hita. Ve titavia Sara yesuru Abaram izi ta sewe.
Saawe tau Abaram imaat, poia to Maaron ila ivool to naatu Isak. Saawe tana, Isak ilepleep igharau yaa Beer Lai Roi.
Pitiiŋ to Ismael ve paaghu tooni

Ene pitiiŋ to Abaram naatu Ismael tomania paaghu tooni. Agar, i besooŋa livaa to Sara. I Isip tinazi tau ipoop Abaram naatu Ismael. Ismael natŋa, ene: Nebaiot, Kedar, Adbel, Mipsam, Misma, Duma, Masa, Adad, Tamar, Yetur, Napis, ve Kedema.

Ismael natŋa paaghu toozi timasa timin naol, ve timin rumei saŋavul ve ru, ve tila tileep izi taan toz toz. Tauta tiwaat Ismael natŋa ezazi pa nugh ve taan toozi tawe. Ismael natŋa saŋavul ve ru tawe tisov timin daaba pa rumei toz toz.
Ismael ndaman tooni irau 137, ra imaat, ve ila ileep tomania ziiri waaro tooni siriv tau timaat muuŋ na.

Ve paaghu tooni tila tileep ila taan sirivu tau igheen bodbodaaŋ pa taan Avila ve taan Sur. Taan tawe igharau yes Isipa taan toozi ziige, ve eez tiina tau ila pa Asiria. Ismael paaghu tooni tivalupu zi mako. Tilepleep soghan soghan pa tauzi.
Rebeka ipoop Esau ve Yakop
Ene sinaiŋ to Abaram naatu Isak tomania paaghu tooni.
Ndaman to Isak irau tamoot ru (40), ra ivai Rebeka. Rebeka taama eeza Betuel. I puughu tooni ivot ila to Aram, ve ileep izi taan sirivu to Mesopotamia. Rebeka liivu eeza Laban.
Rebeka, i livaa uupa. Tauvene Isak isuŋ pa Yoova ve ighasoni ighe iuule. Yoova ilooŋ suŋuuŋ tooni, ve iuul Rebeka gha aapo.

Rebeka iyamaan imin natŋa tipaparav ila aapo loolo. Tauvene isaav pa tauu ighe: “Wai, mindai ta pataŋani tane ivot payau ne?” Ra ila isuŋ pa Yoova, ve ighasoni to ipaghazoŋai pataŋani tawe puughu pani.
Yoova isaav pani ighe:

content.text: “Tamtamon puughu toozi ru ta tileep ila apom loolo.
Ŋgun ru pale tivot ilat tsio, ve tivalagh zi.
Ŋgun ee pale tapiri iliiv ite.
Ve ŋeer olman pale imin besooŋa pa ŋeer muria.”

content: Rebeka saawe tooni to popaaŋ ivot, ve ipoop zitamoot bogboogŋa ru.
Ŋeer olman tiini siŋsiŋai, ve bide ooro. Tauta tiwaat eeza Esau.
Ra taazi ikis toogha aaghe guubu ve aana izi. Tauvene tiwaat eeza Yakop.
Saawe tau Rebeka ipoop geegeu ru tawe, Isak ndaman tooni irau tamoot tol (60).
Tilepleep le geegeu ru tana timin zolman. Esau, i ŋeer to laghlaghooŋ ila su ve iŋgalŋgal ŋgai sagsag. Ve Yakop, i ŋeer marowa, ve ighamgham uraat izi nughei mon.
Isak loolo igheen to Esau. Pasaa, i loolo pa ghaniiŋ ŋgai sagsag to su. Ve Rebeka, i loolo igheen to Yakop.
Esau izughui tauu pa niia to ŋeer aidaaba
Saawe ee, Yakop igharaat sur poia, ve Esau ileep su gha ivot. I pitoola kat le tapiri isov.
Tauvene isaav pa Yakop ighe: “Aiss, yau pitool ghau le nasaghat kat. Sur siŋsiŋai tana, uzoov leg rigta ilam naghun!” (Tauta tiwaat Esau eeza ite tighe Edom.)
Eemon Yakop isaav pani ighe: “Poia. Eemon ituru taparavol pa niaan muuŋ, ve nagham niam namin ŋeer aidaaba, o nazoov lem sur.”
Esau iyol aliiŋa ighe: “Aiss, paita namaat tane. Niag to ŋeer aidaaba, ene kaut sorok. Iuul ghau mindai? Rekia ugham sur tana ilam naghun.”

Yakop isaav pani muul ighe: “Yo aat umbu saveeŋ tomani ghau muuŋ ve upariaaŋa le iyaryaaŋ kat, o nagham payo.” Tauvene Esau imbu saveeŋ tomania, ve ipariaaŋa le iyaryaaŋ kat ighe yesuru tiparavolia niazi, leso Yakop igham i niia gha imin ŋeer aidaaba.

I imbu saveeŋ tomania taazi le isov, ra Yakop igham le mberet tomania sur, gha ighan ma ighun, ve iburig gha ila. Ŋgar tau Esau ighamu na, ene itotoia ighe i maata veleghin niia to ŋeer aidaaba ighe ene kaut sorok.

footnotes.text: Eez Yakop, puughu tauvene: ‘Aaghe guubu.’ Saveeŋ tane, ene saveeŋ palelaaŋ paam. Iŋarui yes tau tighamgham karom.
Saveeŋ Edom igharau rig pa saveeŋ Hibru ziiri ite ‘adom’ tau puughu ‘siŋsiŋai’.
